_comment: Minimum number of tests the suite must report, and how many of them may be skipped. Raise the floor when you add tests; never lower it without saying why in the commit message. A run that reports fewer than this FAILS, even if every test it did run passed — see scripts/check-test-floor.mjs for why. maxSkipped stops the floor from being met by skipped tests: the only conditionally-skipped files are the ones that need a live service — tests/integration/delivery-queue-redis.test.ts (5 tests) and tests/integration/chat-realtime-redis.test.ts (2 tests), both gated on TEST_REDIS_URL, and tests/integration/clamav-live.test.ts (2 tests), gated on TEST_CLAMAV_HOST.
